Rewrite thin product descriptions without made-up claims

The problem. Ask an AI to "rewrite this description" and it adds things you never said: "sturdy", "calming", "perfect for puddles". Customers notice. So do returns.

What you get. Paste your product text or a store link. You get a clean description ready to paste into Shopify, a search title and meta description, and a list of facts to confirm. Nothing is added that your product data does not say.

Why these are different

Anyone can write a prompt. We start from a real task and check what the AI actually does with it.

One job, with real inputs and a clear idea of a good result.

  • Real task. One job, with real inputs and a clear idea of a good result.
  • Baseline. What a plain AI request gets right, before our workflow.
  • Test. Run it on several cases and score every output.
  • Inspect failures. Read what went wrong and look for patterns.
  • Improve. Change a few things at a time.
  • Retest. Keep a change only if the score goes up.
  • Benchmark. Run it once on cases it never saw, and publish the result.
  • 4workflows benchmarked against a plain AI request
  • 1,800+AI outputs scored in our tests
  • 49test cases kept apart from the writing of the workflow
  • 16 of 69workflows failed our hard-input retest. All 16 were fixed and re-run.

Every product is checked on real input before it goes on sale. A badge means it went further. What this means, in full

Review replies

One-line request to a strong AI model: 4 of 20 fully right. With our workflow: 20 of 20. On ChatGPT's free model: 3 of 10 against 10 of 10. The usual failure without it: a reply far too long for a public review, and 4 of 20 promised a refund nobody had offered.

Limits: 10 cases we wrote, run twice. A small test.

When the test goes against us, we say so.

For late-payment emails, a one-line request scored 18 of 20 and our workflow 13 of 20 on a strong model. Ours worked out the interest correctly every time, but it made other mistakes. We are fixing them, and the product does not change until the fix wins on cases it was not written from.
